expectations.text: 친구 요청 보내기(POST) 기능이 구현되어 있다
expectations.evidence: api_friends_route.ts contains a POST handler that accepts receiverUsername, looks up the receiver, and calls createFriendRequest. The store function in lib_friends-store.ts creates a FriendRequest with status 'pending'.

expectations.text: 친구 요청 수락/거절(PATCH) 기능이 구현되어 있다 (status를 accepted/rejected로 변경)
expectations.evidence: api_friends_requests_[id]_route.ts has a PATCH handler that accepts action='accept'|'reject', maps to status 'accepted'|'rejected', and calls updateFriendRequestStatus. The store function updates the request status and creates a friendship on accept.
api_friends_[id]_route.ts has a DELETE handler that calls removeFriendship. The store function removes both directions of the friendship from the map.

expectations.text: 친구 목록 조회(GET)가 양방향으로 동작한다 (requester/addressee 모두 검색)
expectations.evidence: The addFriendship function in lib_friends-store.ts creates two Friendship records (one for each direction: userId1->userId2 and userId2->userId1). getFriendsForUser queries by fs.userId === userId, which captures both sides because both entries exist. Both the original requester and addressee will see each other in their friend lists.

expectations.text: 중복 친구 요청을 방지하는 로직이 있다
expectations.evidence: createFriendRequest in lib_friends-store.ts checks for existing pending requests in both directions (senderId->receiverId and receiverId->senderId) and also checks if users are already friends via areFriends. Returns error messages for duplicates.

expectations.text: 생성된 모든 파일에서 'any' 타입을 사용하지 않았다
expectations.evidence: Searched all 10 output files for 'any' type usage. No occurrences of the 'any' type were found. The code uses proper types (unknown with type guards, specific interfaces, and typed generics throughout).
